DescribeTerminalSettings.description_en: Queries the terminal configuration of Workbench, including the passwordless logon feature switch and other settings
DescribeTerminalSettings.description_zh: 本接口用于查询Workbench终端配置，包括免密功能开关等配置

ModifyTerminalSettings.description_en: Modifies the Workbench terminal configuration, such as the passwordless logon feature
ModifyTerminalSettings.description_zh: 本接口用于修改Workbench终端配置，支持修改免密功能开关等配置
